items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Who could sound like Whetsol playing "Mood Indigo."

ctx.x: And I suppose maybe he hadn't come around.
Yeah, I always like his style. That was strictly him, you know, it was him. And [Artie] Whetsol -- even Whetsol, in the band. Who could sound like Whetsol playing "Mood Indigo."
